_comment: Add these rules to your Firebase RTDB security rules

rules_explanation.watchHistory: Per-user watch history — only the owner can read/write
rules_explanation.reelRemixes: Public read for remix lists; only authenticated users can write their own remix

rules._comment_chatSeqCounters: GAP FIX #1 (true server cursor) — chatSeqCounters/{chatId} backs the assignMessageSeq Cloud Function (functions/index.js). Clients only ever need to READ a chat's current counter for diagnostics; they must NEVER write it directly — the whole point of the transaction() in the function is that it's the single authority handing out seq numbers, and a client write here would let two devices race an increment outside that transaction and hand out a duplicate/out-of-order seq. Writes come only from the Admin-privileged Cloud Function, which bypasses these rules entirely — so .write stays false for everyone, always.
